attribution: Independent third-party software listing. Original authors retain copyright and licenses.
methodology: Includes open-source projects, source-available personal/internal-use tools, noncommercial-only datasets, and external services or licensing-conflict references. License files and README claims were checked independently as of 2026-10-09; suitability, prices and execution are not certified.

resources.name: OpenTakeoff
resources.summary: PDF drawing measurement for area, length, counts and trade quantities, with CSV/Excel exports and agent-ready MCP tooling.
resources.caution: Static browser deployment is documented. One-Click automatic room detection is currently gated by the upstream project; manual polygons remain available.

resources.name: OpenConstructionERP
resources.summary: BOQ editing, composite rates, assemblies, PDF/CAD/BIM quantities, and cost/project management.
resources.caution: Large backend application; not deployable on GitHub Pages alone. Verify regional prices and cost-database licensing before professional use.

resources.name: Bidwright
resources.summary: AI-assisted bid intake, PDF and model takeoff, rate schedules, labor burdens, assemblies and quotations.
resources.caution: Requires Docker and a multi-service stack; AI providers may require separate credentials or paid usage. New and changing quickly.

resources.name: Construction Tender Assembly Builder
resources.summary: Browser estimating tool for BOQ normalization, historical assemblies, cost codes, and rate/productivity adjustments.
resources.caution: Small recent project; the separate Excel workbench advertised by the author is a commercial download, not automatically included in the repository.

resources.name: IfcOpenShell / Ifc5D
resources.summary: IFC quantity and cost automation, schedules of rates, cost items and structured CSV/Excel outputs.
resources.caution: Development toolkit; requires IFC models and Python/IFC knowledge, not a point-and-click PDF takeoff application.

resources.name: FreeCAD BIM
resources.summary: Open-source parametric CAD/BIM application with integrated BIM workbench and quantity-oriented model workflows.
resources.caution: The historical standalone BIM_Workbench addon is obsolete for FreeCAD 1.0+; BIM is integrated into FreeCAD itself.

resources.name: QTO Buccaneer
resources.summary: Python quantity takeoff from IFC models with spreadsheet exports, metrics and reusable workflows.
resources.caution: Requires a working IFC model and Python dependencies; check measurement classification and model completeness.

resources.name: FreeCAD Bill of Materials Workbench
resources.summary: FreeCAD assembly-part bills of materials, including summary BOM and raw material item exports.
resources.caution: A BOM is not necessarily a priced construction BOQ; verify quantity units and assembly scope.

resources.name: PyCostEstimates (pyRevit)
resources.summary: Revit model quantities, composite unit-rate buildup, cost assignment and BOQ export.
resources.caution: Requires Autodesk Revit and pyRevit; Revit itself is proprietary and must be licensed separately.

resources.name: ezdxf
resources.summary: Programmatic reading, creation and analysis of DXF geometry for bespoke CAD takeoff workflows.
resources.caution: DXF geometry does not automatically establish construction pay quantities; layers, units and assemblies need project-specific rules.

resources.name: pdfplumber
resources.summary: Extract tables, text and document geometry from PDF BOQs, tender documents and schedules.
resources.caution: PDF extraction needs reconciliation against original documents; this library is not a finished drawing takeoff application.

resources.name: BuildSuite Core
resources.summary: ERPNext construction addon for BOQ trees, rate libraries, measurement books and subcontract payment processes.
resources.caution: Explicitly marked beta by its maintainer; requires a Frappe/ERPNext instance and suitable accounting configuration.

resources.name: OpenProject Community
resources.summary: Project scheduling, work packages, time records, budgeting, reporting and controlled team collaboration.
resources.caution: Project controls system, not a FIDIC clause interpreter or a dedicated construction variation-valuation engine.

resources.name: Construction Project Control Web App
resources.summary: Single-project budget, progress billing, change-order tracking, retainage and cash-flow demonstration.
resources.caution: Browser code is public; the separate downloadable Excel template is advertised commercially. Do not confuse the two.

resources.name: AI Skills for Construction
resources.summary: Prompt and agent-workflow examples for construction data, BIM analysis, document controls and estimating.
resources.caution: An AI skill collection is guidance, not a verified quantity calculation or contractual entitlement determination.

resources.name: QuantityTakeoff-Python examples
resources.summary: Small Python quantity takeoff examples for grouping and filtering construction model elements.
resources.caution: Older learning material (last repository activity reviewed from 2023); not recommended as a production takeoff engine.

resources.name: Quantity Surveyor AI Skill
resources.summary: Portable QS takeoff, unit-rate build-up, tender comparison, variation and cash-flow instructions.
resources.caution: Requires a suitable AI host. It does not independently measure drawings or guarantee exports.

resources.name: Claude 2D PDF to Priced BOQ
resources.summary: Claude Code pipeline from vector PDF/DXF quantities to trade-based Excel BOQs with your own rates.
resources.caution: Scanned sheets may lack vector information; check quantity evidence, scale and rates.

resources.name: Construction Agent Skills (28)
resources.summary: Twenty-eight construction agent workflows for estimating checks, bids, takeoff and commercial tasks.
resources.caution: Instructions are not an autonomous geometry or pricing engine.

resources.name: Construction Reference MCP
resources.summary: Offline MCP calculators for concrete, earthwork, rebar, waste, markup, retainage and unit references.
resources.caution: Generic factors and cost codes must be validated against actual specifications.

resources.name: Construction Prompts for ChatGPT & Claude
resources.summary: Structured ChatGPT/Claude prompts for RFI, takeoff review, pricing, notices and change orders.
resources.caution: Prompt pack only, not a native installable ChatGPT plugin or an executable estimator.

resources.name: QS Skills — ANZSMM and ACMM
resources.summary: Nineteen quantity-surveying skills for Australian measurement and elemental cost planning.
resources.caution: Measurement standards are jurisdiction-specific and may be copyrighted; consult authoritative licensed standards.

resources.name: Construction PM Claude Plugin
resources.summary: Claude Code plugin for drawings, issue registers, tenders, claims and PM reviews.
resources.caution: Requires local Python dependencies; never substitute for signed contract terms.

resources.name: Bonsai MCP (Blender BIM)
resources.summary: MCP integration for AI-assisted Blender/Bonsai BIM and IFC model tasks.
resources.caution: Needs Blender/Bonsai setup. Check model geometry and measured output.

resources.name: ifcMCP
resources.summary: Query IFC elements, properties, locations and spatial structure using an MCP client.
resources.caution: Python, IfcOpenShell and an IFC file required; not a complete priced BOQ.

resources.name: IFC-MCP Analysis Server
resources.summary: Structured building-model queries, count/area analyses and IFC aggregation with MCP.
resources.caution: Confirm IFC units and categories before cost takeoff.

resources.name: AutoCAD MCP Pro
resources.summary: Automate AutoCAD through Windows COM or a headless ezdxf engine for drawing inspection.
resources.caution: Live CAD requires a licensed Windows AutoCAD installation; DXF headless mode differs.

resources.name: CAD-MCP Server
resources.summary: AI-driven CAD drawing, layer and block management through MCP tools.
resources.caution: Requires supported installed CAD software; approve modifications before use.

resources.name: QCAD MCP
resources.summary: Plan and DXF processing with ezdxf and optional QCAD Pro AI operations.
resources.caution: Some operations require the separately paid QCAD Pro product.

resources.name: BOQ MCP for Claude
resources.summary: Claude tools for BOQ sections, quantities, cost items, bills and contractor records.
resources.caution: Requires a separately hosted BOQ/Tendix account and API, not a local BOQ app.

resources.name: Construction Takeoff Client Plugins
resources.summary: Claude/Codex plugin manifests and setup for Construction Takeoff integrations.
resources.caution: Mac-only release candidate; separately licensed Takeoff app and companion required.

resources.name: BIMserver
resources.summary: IFC model server with revisions and downstream structured-quantity integrations.
resources.caution: Java backend/server, not a completed estimating application.

resources.name: That Open web-ifc
resources.summary: JavaScript/WebAssembly IFC parser for web quantity extraction applications.
resources.caution: Developer SDK; you must build and validate the measurement workflow.

resources.name: That Open Components
resources.summary: Browser BIM viewer/measurement components to incorporate into custom QS tools.
resources.caution: Building a full BOQ system still requires your own interface and logic.

resources.name: BIMsurfer
resources.summary: Web-based IFC model viewer for reviewing quantities in 3D.
resources.caution: Viewer only; cannot deliver costed BOQs by itself.

resources.name: Bldrs Share
resources.summary: Online IFC/CAD model review, visualization and collaboration.
resources.caution: Not an estimating package; verify AGPL requirements before hosting.

resources.name: QGIS
resources.summary: Open-source GIS site-area and terrain measurement environment.
resources.caution: CRS, survey quality and vertical datum affect volumes and plan quantities.

resources.name: EarthWorkQ QGIS Plugin
resources.summary: QGIS earthwork cut/fill calculation and earth-volume reports.
resources.caution: Early-stage project; independently check surface and cut/fill methodology.

resources.name: OpenDroneMap
resources.summary: Process site photographs into orthophotos, DEMs and point clouds.
resources.caution: Drone quantities need control data and survey validation.

resources.name: PDAL Point Cloud Library
resources.summary: LiDAR/point-cloud processing pipelines for terrain datasets.
resources.caution: Programming component, not survey-certified volume calculations.

resources.name: GDAL / OGR
resources.summary: Raster/vector GIS data processing for site quantity automation.
resources.caution: Geospatial drivers have varying licenses and coordinate-unit requirements.

resources.name: Open3D
resources.summary: 3D point-cloud/mesh geometry analysis useful for survey comparisons.
resources.caution: Code library, not a turnkey surveying app.

resources.name: GeoPandas
resources.summary: Python polygon and geospatial analysis of site areas and parcels.
resources.caution: Calculate physical areas using the correct projected CRS.

resources.name: Shapely
resources.summary: Polygon areas, intersections, unions and geometric deductions for takeoff automation.
resources.caution: Unitless planar geometry; convert CAD/GIS units before pricing.

resources.name: LibreCAD 2D
resources.summary: 2D CAD drawing review, DXF editing and geometric measurement.
resources.caution: Not integrated with priced takeoffs; DWG conversion can be needed.

resources.name: Mozilla PDF.js
resources.summary: Browser PDF rendering engine for building custom drawing takeoff interfaces.
resources.caution: PDF rendering alone does not measure areas or assign drawing scale.

resources.name: PaddleOCR
resources.summary: OCR and layout extraction for scanned BOQs and technical schedules.
resources.caution: Verify extracted units, table boundaries and numbers against source.

resources.name: Tesseract OCR
resources.summary: Extract text from scanned drawings and tender documents.
resources.caution: OCR does not establish reliable dimensions or contractual meanings.

resources.name: PyMuPDF
resources.summary: PDF parsing, vector text and drawing annotation automation.
resources.caution: Review AGPL or commercial-license obligations before embedding.

resources.name: pypdf
resources.summary: Split, merge, rotate and organize contract PDFs and bid packages.
resources.caution: No drawing quantification; check combined page numbering and order.

resources.name: ACadSharp (DXF/DWG)
resources.summary: C# .NET library to read/write DWG/DXF for automated drawing analysis.
resources.caution: DXF/DWG support depends on versions; project-specific units and layers need handling.

resources.name: Paperless-ngx
resources.summary: Searchable OCR archive for invoices, contracts and project correspondence.
resources.caution: Not a formal construction EDMS or approved notices register.

resources.name: Google OR-Tools
resources.summary: Optimization algorithms for scheduling and crew/resource scenarios.
resources.caution: Not a forensic CPM or delay-entitlement engine; user must build the model.

resources.name: GanttProject
resources.summary: Gantt charts, task relationships and construction progress planning.
resources.caution: Not full EOT/critical-path entitlement analysis.

resources.name: DDC CWICR Construction Cost Database
resources.summary: Multilingual resource-based construction cost datasets, work items and Python/AI workflow adapters for studying rate build-ups.
resources.caution: Data explicitly allows personal research/evaluation with attribution; not for paid estimating services without a DDC commercial license. Keep source provenance notices; the book has separate terms.

resources.name: AutoConst Claude Construction Takeoff Skill
resources.summary: Claude skill for structural drawing takeoffs, concrete/formwork/rebar quantities, marked-up audit images and Excel exports.
resources.caution: Actual LICENSE permits personal/internal use but prohibits resale or commercial redistribution of the tool, despite README stating MIT. Needs Claude subscription and the archived Drawing Analyzer prerequisite; verify quantities.

resources.name: AutoConst Drawing Analyzer (Archived)
resources.summary: Archived drawing-set preprocessor for sheet splitting, polygon extraction and index files used by the original AutoConst takeoff skill.
resources.caution: Upstream explicitly archived this in favor of a newer vector-database workflow. LICENSE allows personal/internal use but not software resale; README's MIT label conflicts. Legacy prerequisite only.

resources.name: AutoConst Claude PDF Markup Skill
resources.summary: Bulk construction PDF stamps, annotations, markup edits and markup-register extraction with Claude.
resources.caution: Original LICENSE allows personal/internal use, but no commercial redistribution or resale. README claims MIT incorrectly. Requires suitable Claude subscription and thorough output review.

resources.name: AutoConst Vector PDF Drawing Takeoff
resources.summary: Claude Code skill and Python CLI indexing vector-PDF labels, schedules and dimensions into a queryable SQLite drawing database.
resources.caution: Requires machine-readable vector text; scanned sheets need a different workflow. The repository LICENSE permits personal/internal use, not resale, despite README saying MIT.

resources.name: AutoConst Construction Project Indexer
resources.summary: Claude Cowork project indexer for drawings, BOQs, specifications, contracts and project-document context.
resources.caution: Indexes may expose confidential project files to the selected AI host; check privacy. License explicitly permits personal/internal use but prohibits resale/distribution of the software as a paid service.

resources.name: AutoConst IFC to Priced BOQ
resources.summary: Claude Code workflow extracting IFC quantities and creating an Excel priced BOQ using your own rate library.
resources.caution: Repository README describes code as MIT but actual LICENSE is source-available: personal/internal use allowed, redistribution as a paid product/service restricted. Rates not included; validate IFC units.

resources.name: AutoConst Legacy PDF Priced BOQ (Archived)
resources.summary: Earlier Claude Code PDF-to-priced-Excel-BOQ workflow with vector text extraction and confidence flags.
resources.caution: Upstream archived; prefer its newer maintained 2D PDF to Priced BOQ successor already listed. This earlier repository's LICENSE is MIT.

resources.name: Estimaite Remote Takeoff MCP
resources.summary: Remote hosted MCP connector advertised for PDF measurements, construction takeoff, unit-rate pricing and proposal exports.
resources.caution: GitHub publishes only the connector manifest/docs, not the hosted server code. Estimaite account/OAuth required; pricing and personal-use rights of the backend must be checked with provider.

resources.name: ConstructFlow Contracting for Odoo
resources.summary: Odoo 19 construction controls with BOQ imports, client certificates, subcontract billing, retention, variation approvals and cost tracking.
resources.caution: README declares proprietary OPL-1 but repository LICENSE and module manifest declare LGPL-3. Conflicting license statements require written clarification before using or republishing; Odoo installation required.

resources.name: Construction AI Plugins — Claude & ChatGPT
resources.summary: Construction RFI, daily report, estimate review, change-order and safety prompt/plugin workflows for Claude and ChatGPT/Codex.
resources.caution: README states MIT but repository has no LICENSE file and also advertises paid plugin bundles and subscription access. Check exactly which files and services are available for personal use before installation.

compatibilityNote: ChatGPT (instructions) means reusable instructions/prompts, NOT a native installable ChatGPT plugin. Claude Code skills and MCP servers are separately identified; their installation depends on the user's AI host.
researchScope: PDF and CAD takeoff, BIM/IFC quantities, rate buildup, contract controls, earthworks/survey workflows, Claude/ChatGPT-compatible prompts and skills, MCP servers. GitLab also searched; no extra candidate admitted without comparable source/license evidence. Personal-study options are shown even when commercial redistribution is restricted; hosted/paid or ambiguous offerings require additional permission.
licenseNotice: Listing or linking is not redistribution. Personal/internal-use grants do not authorize selling or hosting restricted code. CC BY-NC datasets cannot be used in paid estimates without permission. Conflicting or missing licenses should be clarified with the authors. No third-party code/data is mirrored here.
